body: Orchestrator review of PR #359 (dotfiles-T128-project-map-pane-open-a01, head 73f51ab2 on base 727180db), read from the fetched head, not the RESULT: the hook's single new branch runs `terminal-browser open "$file_path" --split right --size 0.5 --no-merge >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0` exactly where the merged hook exited on an empty selection, every other path unchanged; the shdoc description gains the open sentence and a `shortcut:` line naming the accepted consequence (a filter-rejected map tab or a racing write can open a second pane; the hook follow-up tightens the selection), as item 1 states. The merged test's five empty-selection case names (no browser, no map tab, null target, the invalid-port cases, invalid target) gain the one open call in `expected_browser_calls`; the new test `test_project_map_reload_hook_opens_the_pane_when_no_browser_shows_the_map` records argv through the stub terminal-browser and asserts the `--no-merge` open call, the agent log and the exit for its cases. The rule and the SKILL change one sentence each (the hook opens its own pane in a right split of half the width at the first map write when absent, never merging into a neighbouring terminal-browser, and reloads it at every later write). Caps: 10 added and 4 deleted lines outside tests and .orchestration (14 of 200), 105 under tests (of 1000). The Bot's single review (5526425148 on 73f51ab2) left one P2 (4277695198: the suffix-only URL filter can select another repository's map tab), advisory under the owner task dotfiles-T128-project-map-pane-open-a01-followup-a01, written at 00:3xZ with its paired review in flight; no P0/P1. The task copy's sha256 equals the dispatched a2c1196e. No finding.
